title: Latency and polling
sourceReport: Measured per HID report: this is the controller's real polling rate.
sourceChange: Measured on state change: keep moving the stick in circles to measure.
explain: Hz is how many times per second the controller sends data. Jitter is the variation from one report to the next: lower is more stable. Common controllers sit between 125 and 1000 Hz.
noData: No data yet: move the controller.
